name: Storm Step
description:
You dissolve into a bolt of lightning and reappear at a location within range. You arrive at exactly the spot desired. It can be a place you can see, one you can visualize, or one you can describe by stating distance and direction.

Each creature within 5 feet of your departure point must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

You can also teleport one willing creature. The creature must be within 5 feet of you when you teleport, and it teleports to a space within 5 feet of your destination space.

If you or the other creature would arrive in a space occupied by a creature or completely filled by one or more objects, you and any creature traveling with you each take 4d6 Force damage, and the teleportation fails.
summary: You dissolve into a bolt of lightning and reappear at a location within range. Each creature within 5 feet of your departure point must make a Dexterity saving throw against Lightning damage.
notes: Dark Sun homebrew spell. Rework of Dimension Door for the Rain patron domain.
